name: Andorra
headline: Andorra: +3.9% growth in 2025, 2.4% inflation, debt 30% of GDP
sections: Andorra is a $4.5 billion economy (2025), the world's 177th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.9% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $80K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 3.1% of GDP (2024).
Consumer prices rose 2.4% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 6.2% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 1.3% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%.
Gross government debt is 30% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 46% in 2020. The general government balance is +3.6% of GDP (2025), a surplus.
The current account balance is +20.0% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Net FDI inflows were 6.0% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 24% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 84.2 years (2024). Population: 89 thousand (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
